Original note: The rules an employer's contribution to the employee's pension-scheme account feeds (W-238e). By their conditions on employer.fund: SAL-INCLUDES-PENSION-CONTRIBUTION takes it into salary (S2 s.16(k); 1961 s.17(1)(viii)); DED-NPS-EMPLOYER-GOVT, -OTHER and -NEW-TAX-REGIME deduct it (S2 s.124(1)(a), (b), with s.124(2); 1961 s.80CCD(2)). PERQ-EMPLOYER-CONTRIBUTION adds up every employer contribution to a recognised provident fund, the notified pension scheme and an approved superannuation fund and charges the excess over its limit (S2 s.17(1)(h); 1961 s.17(2)(vii); D-126); PERQ-EMPLOYER-ACCRETION charges the accretion on that excess (S2 s.17(1)(i); 1961 s.17(2)(viia); D-127). Neither reads employer.fund in a condition: EmployerContributionNode reaches both with every contribution (W-238e).
